title: MTDKS Measurement Technique Identity and Domain Knowledge (per-technique card)
description: One card per measurement technique. Keyed by meas_ID. Carries the technique identity (name, acronym, family, modality) and domain knowledge (what it measures, how it works, setup, performance, uncertainty). Content follows MTDKS_technique_skill_schema.md. The global index of all techniques lives in MTDKS_meas_summary.json.

database_context.note: Counts from full DB scan of 11,923 papers / 130,104 block_properties entries
database_context.estimated_distinct_techniques: ~160-200 after deduplication of spelling variants and UFactor suffixes

meas_ID_construction.description: meas_ID is a slugified identifier derived from the canonical technique name. Standard methods use the ThermoML eMethodName vocabulary; custom methods use the base abbreviation code or a normalized free-text label.
meas_ID_construction.format: lowercase, underscores for spaces, no special characters

examples.source: custom:KNUDSEN / Calculated from knudsen effusion weight loss

meas_ID_construction.ufactor_note: UFactor variants (e.g. VIBTUB:UFactor:4) share the meas_ID of their base technique (vibrating_tube_method). The UFactor multiplier is per-paper metadata stored in MTDKS INDIV, not per-technique identity.

key.description: Primary key: one card per unique measurement technique.

meas_ID.description: Slugified unique identifier for this technique

name.description: Full canonical name of the technique

acronym.description: Standard abbreviation (e.g. DSC, GC, NMR). Empty string if none.

aliases.description: Alternative names, historical names, vendor-specific names

thermoml_standard_name.description: Exact eMethodName value from ThermoML controlled vocabulary. null if custom-only technique.

measurement_family.description: Parent technique family from MTDKS_meas_summary.technique_families (e.g. Densimetry, Calorimetry, Viscometry)

contact.description: Whether the probe physically contacts the sample

destructive.description: Whether the sample is consumed or altered

in_situ.description: Whether measurement occurs in the process environment

db_usage.description: Usage statistics for this technique in the ThermoML database

instance_count.description: Total block-property instances using this technique (across all papers)

property_groups.description: Property groups this technique serves in the DB

n_papers.description: Number of distinct DOIs using this technique

name.description: [audited] Present in 100.0% of cards. Example: Chromatography

domain_knowledge.description: Technical knowledge about this measurement technique. Two sub-blocks: structured (machine-parseable JSON) and description (agent-readable prose). Structure follows MTDKS_technique_skill_schema.md.

structured_block.description: Machine-parseable technique characteristics. See MTDKS_technique_skill_schema.md section 1 for full field reference.

measurement_scope.description: What this technique measures: direct observables, derived quantities, target properties, phases, sample compatibility.

direct_observables.description: Quantities the instrument directly records (signal level)

derived_observables.description: Quantities computed from direct observables via models or calibration

target_properties.description: Thermodynamic/physical properties this technique determines; maps to PCS property_names

phases_measured.description: Applicable phase states (from PCS phases list)

supported_sample_types.description: Sample forms the technique can handle (pure liquid, binary mixture, powder, thin film, ...)

unsupported_sample_types.description: Sample forms incompatible with this technique

typical_output_formats.description: Data products (thermogram, isotherm, spectrum, single value, ...)

units.description: Key quantity to SI unit mapping for this technique

experimental_parameters.description: What is controlled (constraints) and what is varied (variables) during measurement.

constraints.description: Parameters held fixed during a measurement run (T, P, composition, ...)

variables.description: Parameters systematically varied to produce comparison data (the x-axis)

setup_and_requirements.description: Instrument hardware, environment, sample preparation, calibration, and consumables.

instrument_components.description: Key hardware parts (cell, transducer, furnace, detector, ...)

environmental_requirements.description: Lab conditions needed (temperature stability, vibration isolation, inert atmosphere, ...)

reference_materials.description: Standard reference substances or certified values used

consumables.description: Items consumed per run (crucibles, columns, gases, ...)

performance.description: Quantitative performance envelope of the technique.

sensitivity.description: Smallest detectable change in the target property

dynamic_range.description: Ratio of largest to smallest measurable signal

measurement_speed.description: Time per single measurement or scan

data_and_interpretation.description: How raw signals become results: signal type, processing, models, artifacts, QC.

raw_signal_type.description: Physical nature of the raw signal (voltage, frequency, mass loss, heat flow, ...)

analysis_methods.description: Curve fitting, peak integration, extrapolation, equation of state, ...

model_assumptions.description: Physical models or approximations applied during analysis

common_artifacts.description: Known artifacts that can contaminate results

quality_control_checks.description: Reproducibility tests, standard checks, internal consistency tests

failure_modes.description: Conditions under which the technique produces unreliable or meaningless results

systematic_sources.description: Calibration bias, sample impurity, model error

operator_dependence.description: Degree to which results depend on operator skill

model_dependence.description: Degree to which results depend on chosen model

dominant_error_sources.description: The 1-3 largest contributors to total uncertainty

reported_as.description: How uncertainty is expressed: combined standard uncertainty, expanded (k=2), confidence interval, ...

thermoml_encoding.description: How ThermoML encodes this technique uncertainty: nCombExpandUncertValue at 95% confidence, plus optional UFactor multiplier for custom variants

description_block.description: Prose description sections following MTDKS_technique_skill_schema.md section 2. Each key is a section heading; value is free-text content written by domain expert or LLM.

sections.description: One-paragraph summary of what the technique measures and why it is used
Measurement workflow from sample loading through signal collection and readout
Physical/chemical/statistical principle behind the measurement; governing equations
Instrument configuration, key components, geometry, operating environment
Materials, samples, scientific questions, and property ranges where this technique excels
Technical, physical, practical, and interpretive limits
Cleaning, degassing, mounting, conditioning, storage, handling requirements
Calibration protocol: reference materials, frequency, systematic errors corrected
How raw signals become meaningful quantities; models applied; validation against literature
Frequent mistakes in setup, acquisition, analysis, interpretation, and reporting
Major artifact sources, conditions triggering failure, detection and mitigation
Minimum parameters, sample details, and uncertainty info required for reproducibility
